description: Implementation of a connecting client socket for QUIC protocol within an event loop, including connection management, asynchronous and blocking send/receive operations, and socket lifecycle handling.

classes.name: EventLoopConnectingClientSocket
classes.description: A socket class that manages connection, sending, and receiving data over a network within an event loop, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous operations, with connection state management.

methods.name: ConnectBlocking
methods.description: Establishes a connection in a blocking manner.

methods.name: Disconnect
methods.description: Closes the socket and resets state.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local socket address after connection.

methods.name: ReceiveBlocking
methods.description: Receives data in a blocking manner.

methods.name: SendBlocking
methods.description: Sends data in a blocking manner.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes and cleans up the socket.

methods.name: GetConnectResult
methods.description: Checks the result of an asynchronous connect.

methods.name: FinishOrRearmAsyncConnect
methods.description: Handles completion or rearming of async connect.

methods.name: FinishOrRearmAsyncReceive
methods.description: Handles completion or rearming of async receive.

methods.name: OneBytePeek
methods.description: Peeks at one byte to check socket state.

methods.name: SendBlockingInternal
methods.description: Internal method to send data in blocking mode.

methods.name: SendInternal
methods.description: Internal method to send data asynchronously.

methods.name: FinishOrRearmAsyncSend
methods.description: Handles completion or rearming of async send.
